## James Bond Revenue Over Time

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

The Bond films in this dataset were released between `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` and `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond
#| fig-cap: "James Bond worldwide revenue over time"
#| echo: true

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Box Office Revenue")
plt.show()
```
